params.prompt: Original instrumental score for a 2 minute 30 second presentation trailer of a hand-painted space exploration adventure game about a young engineering student from Ecuador who dreams of the Moon. Warm cinematic orchestra (piano, strings, soft brass, timpani) with a gentle electronic pulse, hopeful, emotional, full of wonder. Steady tempo of 90 BPM throughout. Structure: 0:00 to 0:11 almost silent, only a very faint low warm drone. At 0:11 one single soft solo piano note, alone. At 0:13 a second solo piano note. At 0:15 a warm full chord of strings and piano that swells and then settles. 0:17 to 1:10 a calm, steady underscore bed meant to sit under a live spoken presentation: soft repeating piano arpeggios, sustained warm strings and a quiet pulsing synth on every beat, no lead melody in front, gradually a little fuller. 1:10 to 1:22 an energetic rhythmic section with light drums, a driving pulse and bright plucked synths, playful and adventurous, with a clear downbeat every two beats. 1:22 to 2:03 back to the steady underscore bed with the pulse, warm and confident, still no lead melody. 2:03 to 2:22 a big emotional crescendo: rising strings, timpani rolls and brass, the main theme finally played in full. At 2:22 a broad, bright major final chord that rings out and fades naturally to silence by 2:30. Instrumental only: no vocals, no choir, no humming, no lyrics.
